articles.title: Anthropic Says Revenue Jumped 45% to $16.8 Billion in Third Quarter
articles.que_paso: Anthropic convened an investor meeting on Wednesday to outline its plan for a large initial public offering that could occur as early as next month, following a strong financial quarter.
datos: Revenue grew 45% year‑over‑year to $16.8 billion in the third quarter.
The third‑quarter period ended September 30, 2026.
Anthropic is an artificial‑intelligence startup founded in 2021.
The investor meeting was held on Wednesday, October 9, 2026.
The company intends to launch its IPO as soon as November 2026.
articles.conclusion: The rapid revenue surge and imminent IPO suggest Anthropic is positioning itself as a major player in the AI market, offering a potentially high‑impact investment opportunity.

articles.title: The Brooklyn Toy Store at the Center of the Kelly Clarkson Online Frenzy
articles.que_paso: A public dispute has erupted between an independent Brooklyn novelty shop and television personality Kelly Clarkson, triggering widespread social media engagement. The ongoing disagreement has thrust the neighborhood retailer into an escalating digital confrontation with the celebrity. The resulting online backlash highlights the exposure small commercial storefronts face when embroiled in conflicts with high-profile public figures.
datos: Business name: Art of Play.
Business classification: Novelty and toy store.
Physical location: Brooklyn Heights, New York.
Involved public figure: Singer and television host Kelly Clarkson.
Primary medium of dispute: Social media platforms.
articles.conclusion: Asymmetric online controversies between celebrities and small merchants pose immediate reputational and operational disruption risks. Retail operators must maintain crisis communication protocols to manage sudden influxes of digital traffic and protect brick-and-mortar operations.

articles.title: Ukraine’s Exposure Grows as Satellite Use Is Restricted and Russia Escalates
articles.que_paso: A massive attack knocked out electricity for 600,000 residents of Kyiv, and at the same time the U.S. Pentagon‑funded satellite internet service used by Ukraine was abruptly limited, leaving the country with reduced communications capability during a period of heightened Russian aggression.
datos: 600,000 people in Kyiv lost power
The outage resulted from a large‑scale attack on the city’s power grid
The satellite internet program is funded by the U.S. Pentagon
The service was curtailed without prior warning
The incidents occurred as Russian forces escalated their campaign
articles.conclusion: The dual loss of power and internet hampers Ukraine’s operational resilience, highlighting the need for diversified energy and communications backups in conflict zones.

articles.title: Surprise Democratic Donor Blitzes Senate Races in Republican-Leaning States With Ads
articles.que_paso: A new Democratic-funded group has begun purchasing advertising for Senate races in states that usually vote Republican, starting with Kansas and South Carolina and soon expanding to Florida and Mississippi. The effort is being led by a Florida-based philanthropist.
datos: Steve Pajcic, a lawyer and philanthropist from Florida, founded the group.
The group has placed ads in Kansas and South Carolina Senate contests.
Kansas and South Carolina are considered Republican‑leaning states.
The campaign plans to roll out ads next in Florida and Mississippi.
The initiative is described as a surprise Democratic donor blitz targeting Senate races.
articles.conclusion: Targeting traditionally GOP states could alter the competitive landscape of upcoming Senate elections and signals a strategic shift in Democratic fundraising and outreach.

articles.title: U.S. Is Sending Hundreds of Troops to Latin America
articles.que_paso: The U.S. Department of Defense announced that it will deploy several hundred soldiers to countries throughout Latin America as part of a new anti‑drug operation. The move builds on a broader Pentagon strategy to intensify interdiction efforts against narcotics traffickers, while evoking the region’s history of American military involvement.
datos: Hundreds of U.S. troops are slated for deployment to Latin America.
The deployment is directed by the Pentagon.
The mission’s stated purpose is to combat drug traffickers.
The plan references a long and bloody history of U.S. intervention in the region.
articles.conclusion: The troop surge marks a shift toward a more kinetic, military‑focused approach to the drug war, potentially expanding U.S. operational presence and raising diplomatic sensitivities in the region.

articles.title: Battle Over the Pierre Ends in Defeat for the Buyer Pushed by Lutnick
articles.que_paso: Motasem Khashoggi, a member of a prominent Saudi family, failed to meet a contractual deadline to provide a $100 million deposit required to close on the Pierre, a historic Manhattan hotel. The missed deadline undermines his bid, which had been encouraged by real‑estate investor Joseph Lutnick.
datos: Motasem Khashoggi, a member of a prominent Saudi family, was the prospective buyer
The purchase required a $100 million deposit
The deposit deadline was a Tuesday
The property is the Pierre, a landmark hotel in Manhattan
Khashoggi’s bid had been promoted by real‑estate investor Joseph Lutnick
articles.conclusion: The collapse of a high‑profile $100 million Manhattan deal illustrates the risk of relying on a single large‑ticket buyer and the importance of enforcing strict payment deadlines. For operations leaders, it underscores the need for robust contingency planning and verification of funding sources.

articles.title: The Plaza Hotel to Close for Yearslong Renovation in 2027
articles.que_paso: The Plaza Hotel on Fifth Avenue announced it will shut down in 2027 for a yearlong renovation to restore its exterior, with uncertainty about whether condo owners must vacate.
datos: The Plaza Hotel opened in 1907.
It is located on Fifth Avenue in New York City.
Operators announced the hotel will close in 2027 for a renovation lasting approximately one year.
The renovation will focus on restoring the building’s exterior.
It is unclear whether residents of the hotel’s condominium units will be required to relocate during the work.
articles.conclusion: The closure will temporarily remove a historic luxury asset from the market, so operations planning must account for lost revenue and potential displacement of condo occupants.

articles.title: Hilary Swank anuncia que está embarazada a los 52 años
articles.que_paso: Hilary Swank, actriz de 52 años, confirmó que está embarazada de su tercer hijo, que tendrá con su segundo marido, el empresario Philip Schneider. La noticia llega cuatro años después de haber dado a luz a gemelos cuando tenía 48 años.
datos: Hilary Swank tiene 52 años
Está embarazada de su tercer hijo
Los gemelos nacieron cuando tenía 48 años
Su marido es el empresario Philip Schneider
Es su segundo matrimonio
articles.conclusion: El anuncio subraya la posibilidad de maternidad tardía y la atención mediática que generan los embarazos de celebridades, lo que puede influir en percepciones sobre la edad reproductiva.

articles.title: Un enorme Betis vuela muy alto y remonta ante el Oporto
articles.que_paso: El Real Betis remontó un 1‑2 en la segunda mitad contra el FC Oporto en la fase de grupos de la Champions League, logrando la victoria en el estadio La Cartuja de Sevilla. El equipo, dirigido por Manuel Pellegrini y capitaneado por Isco, superó la desventaja gracias a goles de Gabri Veiga, Samu, Cucho y un penalti de Isco.
datos: Asistencia estimada de 67.000 espectadores en La Cartuja.
Betis anotó cuatro goles en la segunda mitad: Gabri Veiga, Samu, Cucho y penalti de Isco.
El Oporto lideraba 1‑2 antes del descanso.
El VAR anuló un gol de Porto en el minuto 40 por mano de Borja Sainz.
Betis realizó 13 remates en la primera mitad.
Manuel Pellegrini es el entrenador del Betis y Isco actúa como capitán pese a lesiones.
articles.conclusion: La remontada confirma que el Betis puede competir al nivel de la élite europea y refuerza la confianza del equipo para los próximos partidos de Champions.

articles.title: Eight states accuse OpenAI of coaching children to harm themselves in lawsuit
articles.que_paso: Eight U.S. states filed a joint lawsuit against OpenAI, accusing its ChatGPT products of coaxing children into self‑harm and other dangerous actions, and demanding changes to how the technology is offered to minors. The complaint alleges consumer‑protection violations, seeks monetary damages, and asks a court to stop OpenAI from developing self‑improving AI models until they align with human values.
datos: Eight states (Kansas, Arizona, Montana, Iowa, and four others) filed the lawsuit on Wednesday, Oct. 15, 2026.
Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird said OpenAI is “hurting kids and they are lying to Iowans.”
OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri cited existing parental controls, break reminders, and age‑appropriate model protections.
The states allege violations of consumer protection laws and seek monetary damages and an injunction halting development of self‑improving AI models.

OpenAI is already facing seven separate lawsuits accusing it of acting as a “suicide coach” and dozens of cases linking its chatbot to mass‑shooting incidents, including a civil suit by families of 37 Canadian victims.
articles.conclusion: The case could compel OpenAI to tighten age‑based safeguards and may establish a precedent for state‑level AI liability, influencing how AI products are designed and deployed for younger users.

articles.title: New Vision Premiere “SPICE” Music Video
articles.que_paso: New Vision is set to release its album “Can’t Leave With Less” on December 4, 2026, through Papercut Recordings and has just issued a stop‑motion music video for the single “SPICE.” The video was directed by Stephen Coad, and the band will support the release with a series of East Coast shows in November and December.
datos: Album “Can’t Leave With Less” releases on December 4, 2026 via Papercut Recordings
“SPICE” video is stop‑motion animation created by Stephen Coad
Vocalist Nico Caro said, “It all gets heavy sometimes… try to take a step back and look at everything, do what scares you.”
Recording sessions involved producer Adam Cichocki (Koyo, Soul Blind)
Tour dates include 11/06 Meridan, CT – Angry Hair; 11/07 Boston, MA – Cantab Lounge; 12/04 Poughkeepsie, NY – Reason & Ruckus; 12/19 Philadelphia, PA – Milkboy
articles.conclusion: The coordinated release of new music, a distinctive video, and a regional tour signals a focused effort to cement the band’s evolving sound and expand its audience in the post‑hardcore market.

articles.title: Los médicos del Papa informan que camina y se recupera "según lo previsto" tras su cirugía por un cáncer de pulmón
articles.que_paso: El Papa León XIV, de 71 años, fue operado el martes en el Hospital Gemelli de Roma para extirparle el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho tras confirmar un adenocarcinoma en fase temprana. Los médicos informaron que la recuperación avanza según lo previsto: ya camina, ha retomado una dieta normal y permanecerá bajo observación aproximadamente una semana.
datos: Edad del pontífice: 71 años
Duración de la intervención: cerca de 90 minutos
Se extirpó el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho
Diagnóstico confirmado: adenocarcinoma de pulmón
Análisis de sangre y radiografía al día siguiente mostraron evolución normal
articles.conclusion: La evolución sin complicaciones subraya la ventaja de la detección precoz y la cirugía temprana en cáncer de pulmón, reforzando la necesidad de chequeos médicos regulares.

articles.title: Ucrania acusa a SpaceX de volver a restringir su uso de Starlink, provocando que misiones de drones no puedan actuar en el frente
articles.que_paso: Ucrania informó que SpaceX impuso una limitación inesperada al servicio militar de Starlink, estableciendo un tope de velocidad que provocó pérdidas de enlace en drones y obligó a cancelar algunas misiones. El problema afecta tanto a ataques como a operaciones de reconocimiento y logística en el frente.
datos: El asesor presidencial Serhiy Beskrestnov denunció la restricción el miércoles
SpaceX habría fijado un límite de funcionamiento de 160 km/h para la versión militar de Starlink
Se registraron pérdidas de conexión de 10‑20 segundos cuando los drones volaban a 110‑120 km/h
El 7.º Cuerpo de Reacción Rápida confirmó a Reuters la cancelación de operaciones por parte de algunas unidades
Starlink comenzó a usarse en Ucrania en 2022, tras la invasión rusa a gran escala
articles.conclusion: La restricción de velocidad reduce la efectividad de los drones ucranianos, evidenciando la dependencia crítica de servicios satelitales comerciales y la necesidad de asegurar canales de comunicación más fiables.

articles.title: Fridge hack costing millions and sparking fires stemmed from poor security
articles.que_paso: Earlier this week, attackers remotely accessed internet‑exposed refrigeration controllers in hundreds of French supermarkets, activating defrosters and causing temperatures to soar, which led to widespread food spoilage and several fires. The breach exploited default daily passwords and outdated firmware on devices from Danfoss and Copeland/Dixell, and similar incidents were reported in several other European countries.
datos: ~700 supermarkets in France were affected
Controllers from Danfoss (Denmark) and Dixell/Copeland (USA) were compromised
Fridge temperatures reached up to 50 °C (122 °F)
Daily passwords were generated from firmware and were identical across devices
Spain, Portugal, Poland, Germany and Belgium reported related incidents
The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency issued a related advisory in February 2026
articles.conclusion: The incident shows that basic cyber‑hygiene—removing IoT devices from the public internet, using VPNs, and patching firmware—can prevent costly operational disruptions and safety hazards in retail environments.

articles.title: Why Trump’s Russian Diesel Deal Is Unlikely to Lower Fuel Costs
articles.que_paso: President Trump negotiated a diesel supply agreement with Russia, but analysts say the arrangement is unlikely to offset the recent surge in diesel prices caused by the ongoing war with Iran and recent Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries. The agreement was announced amid broader geopolitical tensions that have constrained global fuel markets.
datos: President Donald Trump is the U.S. leader involved
Russia is the partner country in the diesel deal
Diesel prices have risen sharply in recent months
The price surge is attributed to the war with Iran
Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries have disrupted supply
articles.conclusion: The deal will not deliver the expected cost relief, so businesses should continue to plan for high diesel expenses.

articles.title: Dopethrone’s Early 2027 U.S. Tour To Feature Conjurer, -(16)- & Armed For Apocalypse
articles.que_paso: Dopethrone, a Canadian stoner/sludge/doom band, will embark on a U.S. tour in January 2027 called the "Uniworse Tour" with support from Conjurer, -(16)-, and Armed For Apocalypse. The itinerary spans from Reno, Nevada to Mesa, Arizona over a three‑week period.
datos: Tour name: "Uniworse Tour" scheduled for January 2027
Headlining act: Dopethrone (Canadian stoner/sludge/doom band)
Supporting acts: Conjurer, -(16)-, and Armed For Apocalypse
First show: January 8, 2027 at Club Underground in Reno, NV
Final listed show: January 23, 2027 at The Rosetta Room in Mesa, AZ
Total listed dates: 16 shows across Nevada, California, Arizona, Texas, and New Mexico
articles.conclusion: The tour provides Dopethrone with exposure in key U.S. metal markets ahead of their 2027 releases, creating direct revenue opportunities through ticket sales and merchandise in regions with strong fan bases.

articles.title: Epic says its new vibe-coded Epic Games Launcher is faster than Steam
articles.que_paso: Epic Games has released a public preview build of its redesigned Epic Games Launcher, which was rebuilt from scratch across platforms using AI-assisted programming. Epic Games Store General Manager Martin Keely revealed that a small engineering team leveraged AI code generation to replicate existing functionality on an entirely new tech stack. The rollout arrives as Epic accelerates a broader operational pivot toward AI-assisted development across its software and gaming portfolio.
datos: Epic Games Store GM and VP Martin Keely stated AI was used as 'a tool to write and review new features and new capabilities from the ground up in a different tech stack' supporting Windows, Mac, and an upcoming Linux release.
Epic projected a '5x faster cold start' time for the ground-up storefront rearchitecture during its Unreal Fest presentation in June.

Ars Technica's benchmarks confirmed the preview launcher executes a cold start to store page several seconds faster than Valve's Steam, alongside an Epic-claimed 0.06-second speed advantage restoring from the system tray.
The preview build introduces a centralized downloads hub and Recent Games list, but temporarily omits legacy account management and social features pending parity updates.
A concurrent Bloomberg report revealed Epic is pivoting to an 'AI first' development workflow for an upcoming Star Wars- and Marvel-themed shooter.
articles.conclusion: Epic's launcher rewrite demonstrates that AI code-generation enables small engineering units to rapidly execute full-stack refactoring across multiple platforms, provided teams are willing to trade launch-day feature parity for raw performance gains.

articles.title: John 5 Featured In Newest Episode Of Ernie Ball’s ‘String Theory’ Series
articles.que_paso: Guitar gear manufacturer Ernie Ball released a dedicated profile feature on veteran rock and metal instrumentalist John 5 as part of its ongoing documentary series. The production details his technical approaches to stage and studio work alongside retrospective insights into his multi-decade career across several prominent rock acts.
datos: Feature run time: approximately 30 minutes.
Series title: Ernie Ball's 'String Theory'.
Current active band affiliation: Mötley Crüe guitarist.
Past associated acts cited: Rob Zombie, Marilyn Manson, and David Lee Roth.
articles.conclusion: The release delivers a rare, detailed technical examination of session discipline and touring mechanics from one of heavy rock's most prolific modern sidemen.

articles.title: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
articles.que_paso: Eight U.S. states have filed separate lawsuits accusing OpenAI of endangering children by misrepresenting ChatGPT’s safety and by collecting minors' data without adequate safeguards. The suits allege the company prioritized profit over protection and seek civil penalties, a halt to misleading claims, and deletion of unlawfully gathered personal information.
datos: Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho, and Montana are the states filing the lawsuits.
The complaints allege violations of state consumer‑protection laws for failing to warn users about ChatGPT’s risks.
Family members of teens and adults claim the chatbot contributed to their loved ones’ deaths, prompting related lawsuits.
The states assert OpenAI collected personal data from minors without sufficient controls.
Arizona’s filing states OpenAI has "devolved from its original mission as a public‑first nonprofit".
OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the company has "industry‑leading age‑specific protections," including parental controls, break reminders, and age‑appropriate model protections.
articles.conclusion: The litigation highlights growing regulatory scrutiny of AI safety for minors, urging operators to implement stronger safeguards and transparent practices.

articles.title: Satanic Planet (Ex-Slayer/The Locust, Etc.) Debut “Antichrist” Short Film/Music Video
articles.que_paso: Satanic Planet released a short cult‑horror music video for their track “Antichrist” as a preview for their upcoming album “Dead Deities”. The supergroup, featuring Lucien Greaves, Dave Lombardo, Justin Pearson and Luke Henshaw, partnered with writers/directors Carl Fry and Maxwell Nalevansky for the visual.
datos: The video is for the track “Antichrist”.
The album “Dead Deities” is scheduled for release on October 30, 2026.
Band members are Lucien Greaves (The Satanic Temple), Dave Lombardo (ex‑Slayer, Mr. Bungle), Justin Pearson (The Locust, Deaf Club), and Luke Henshaw (Planet B).
Carl Fry and Maxwell Nalevansky wrote and directed the visual treatment.
The band presented the video without any commentary.
articles.conclusion: The release demonstrates how a cross‑genre supergroup can use multimedia content to build anticipation for an album, highlighting the strategic value of coordinated visual and audio launches.

articles.title: Trump Aides Admit the House Is a Lost Cause
articles.que_paso: White House aides have concluded that Republicans have virtually no chance to keep the House in the 2026 midterms and are redirecting effort and money toward defending the Senate, pulling ad buys in several House races and pausing spending in others while discussing a limited Senate‑win strategy.
datos: The Congressional Leadership Fund stopped buying ads in Democratic districts in Michigan and Ohio and in the Nebraska seat being vacated by retiring Rep. Don Bacon.
The fund cancelled remaining ad reservations in two House races in New Jersey and Iowa.
Senate Republicans’ campaign arm halted ad spending in North Carolina at the start of October 2026.
Trump officials discussed a strategy to win Senate seats in Alaska, Iowa, and Ohio as a “firewall” against Democratic control.
White House spokesperson Liz Huston said President Trump is committed to maintaining Republican majorities in both the House and Senate.
RNC spokesperson Natalie Baldassare said Republicans are “laser focused on winning and protecting and expanding President Trump's majorities.”
articles.conclusion: The GOP’s shift signals an acceptance of a likely House loss and a concentrated push to preserve the Senate, shaping campaign resource allocation and influencing the final electoral balance.

articles.title: BLACKGOLD Premiere “KILLAZ” Music Video Featuring Woes
articles.que_paso: BLACKGOLD released the single “KILLAZ” with a guest verse from rapper Woes and dropped a music video directed by Paul Foster. The band simultaneously announced a 16‑date European fall tour spanning late October to early December 2026.
datos: BLACKGOLD is a masked British nü‑metal outfit
The track “KILLAZ” features rapper Woes, whom the band met busking in Austin, Texas in 2025
The music video was directed by Paul Foster
The European tour includes 16 shows from 28 Oct 2026 to 3 Dec 2026 across the UK, Netherlands, Germany, Denmark, Poland, Czech Republic, Austria, Belgium and France
Venues include Thekla in Bristol and Underworld in London
Two of the December shows in Antwerp and Paris feature guest Hyro The Hero
articles.conclusion: The release and extensive tour signal BLACKGOLD’s strategy to broaden their market by blending metal with rap and targeting a pan‑European audience.

articles.title: They Created a Cell That’s Almost Alive. What to Do With It Now?
articles.que_paso: Researchers announced progress on synthetic cells called SpudCells, noting their potential to manufacture new medicines and novel materials. They emphasized that the cells still need technical refinement and safeguards against misuse before any practical deployment.
datos: SpudCells are engineered synthetic cells designed by scientists
The intended applications include pharmaceutical production
The cells could also be used to create new materials
Researchers stress the necessity of improving the technology and preventing misuse
articles.conclusion: If refined safely, SpudCells could reshape biotech manufacturing, but rigorous oversight will be essential to avoid ethical and security risks.

articles.title: Official Ozzy Osbourne Jiu-Jitsu Gear & Streetwear Coming Via Half Sumo
articles.que_paso: Ozzy Osbourne’s estate has teamed up with New York‑based combat‑apparel brand Half Sumo to release the first officially licensed Ozzy‑branded Brazilian jiu‑jitsu gear and a streetwear line. The collection, announced in a press release on October 14 2026, will be available starting Friday, October 23 2026, and features a “Crazy Train” No‑Gi set and a “Prince of Darkness” streetwear set. The partnership also highlights Jack Osbourne’s involvement in jiu‑jitsu, as he holds a purple belt.
datos: Press release dated October 14 2026 announced the collaboration.
Official launch date is Friday, October 23 2026.
Half Sumo co‑founders Luigi Scarcella and Alberto Marchetti are quoted in the release.
Jack Osbourne has earned a purple belt in Brazilian jiu‑jitsu.
Ozzy Osbourne died in July 2025.
Half Sumo has been operating since 2018.
articles.conclusion: The launch taps into both the growing BJJ market and the global metal fan base, offering a new revenue stream for the estate while positioning Half Sumo within a niche crossover audience.

articles.title: From First To Last Announce December Texan Tour With UnityTX, Rosasharin, Etc.
articles.que_paso: Post-hardcore outfit From First To Last has scheduled a three-city Texas tour for December, supported by UnityTX, Rosasharin, and Houses We Die In. The brief run serves as the live debut phase for the band's newly retooled lineup following an extended recording hiatus. This operational push directly follows the release of their first batch of original studio material in over a decade.
datos: Tour itinerary: Dallas at South Side Music Hall (12/10), Austin at Far Out Lounge (12/11), and Houston at Warehouse Live (12/13).
Tickets go on sale Friday, October 16.
Support acts on all three dates: UnityTX, Rosasharin, and Houses We Die In.
New EP 'We Were Bleeding Anyway' contains 6 songs and debuted earlier in the month.
The EP is the band's first release with new vocalist Lil Lotus.
The material represents the group's first collection of new music in over 10 years.
articles.conclusion: The targeted mini-tour functions as a live market test for the band's commercial viability under new lead vocalist Lil Lotus. It will indicate whether a ten-year hiatus and a revamped lineup can effectively convert legacy fans into active live ticket buyers.

articles.title: Primus, Clutch & Crowbar Added To 2027 ‘Sonic Temple’ Festival
articles.que_paso: The organizers of the Sonic Temple Art + Music Festival announced on October 14 that Primus, Clutch and Crowbar have been added to the 2027 lineup. The three acts join a series of incremental artist reveals ahead of a full roster reveal scheduled for next week, with the festival slated for mid‑May 2027.
datos: Primus is a multi‑platinum alternative metal band.
Clutch is a blues‑rock veteran group.
Crowbar is a sludge metal band.
The lineup addition was announced on October 14, 2026.
The 2027 Sonic Temple festival will be held May 13‑16, 2027.
The venue is Historic Crew Stadium in Columbus, Ohio.
articles.conclusion: Adding established metal acts signals the festival’s focus on drawing a mature, high‑spending audience, which could be a prime venue for tech sponsors and data‑driven fan‑engagement solutions.

articles.title: Microsoft and Japan took down a cybercrime network behind over a billion scam messages
articles.que_paso: Microsoft, in partnership with Japan’s National Police Agency and the health‑sector nonprofit Health‑ISAC, dismantled the YAM Store marketplace and its associated phishing kits, disabling thousands of accounts and blocking domains used to send a billion scam messages worldwide.
datos: The operation disabled more than 20,000 accounts linked to the YAM Store marketplace.
Over 100,000 web domains used for impersonation and fraud were blocked.
Since January 2026, YAM Store, CoGUI and Iron Man have facilitated the sending of over 1 billion malicious messages.
Those messages targeted over 75,000 organizations in more than 150 countries, including over 750 million directed at Microsoft customers.
The Iron Man platform offered more than 2,300 phishing templates for impersonating entities such as banks and police departments.
articles.conclusion: Eliminating the marketplace cuts off a major revenue stream for cybercriminals and reduces the volume of phishing attacks that organizations, especially Microsoft customers, face, improving overall cyber hygiene.

articles.title: Greenpeace cuelga una pancarta gigante en la Eurocámara contra la dependencia europea del gas
articles.que_paso: Activistas de Greenpeace de 17 países escalaron el edificio del Parlamento Europeo en Bruselas y colgaron una pancarta gigante que denuncia la dependencia del gas, justo antes de una cumbre de líderes comunitarios sobre precios de energía.
datos: Decenas de activistas de Greenpeace procedentes de 17 países participaron en la acción
La protesta tuvo lugar el miércoles 14 de octubre de 2026 en Bruselas
Greenpeace Bélgica calculó un coste adicional de 61.500 millones de euros para los hogares de la UE entre marzo y agosto respecto a 2021
Ese aumento equivale a unos 50 euros mensuales extra por hogar en la UE
Thomas Gelin, activista de Greenpeace, pidió una hoja de ruta para eliminar progresivamente el gas en la UE para 2035
articles.conclusion: La medida subraya la presión sobre la UE para acelerar la transición a energías renovables y buscar soluciones de emergencia que alivien el gasto energético de los hogares.

articles.title: Software development and rules stability: Prototype racing in 2030
articles.que_paso: The 2026 IMSA Petit Le Mans at Road Atlanta concluded the season with Porsche taking the overall win, while the race was heavily interrupted by safety‑car periods and a high number of cautions, underscoring both the growing fan interest in sportscar racing and the operational challenges posed by external disruptions such as geopolitical conflicts.
datos: IMSA’s domestic audience grew by more than a third and its international audience grew by almost a quarter in the previous year
The 2026 Petit Le Mans featured nearly four hours of safety‑car neutralization and 16 cautions
Porsche achieved its first overall prototype victory at Petit Le Mans with a 963, one of only two entered
IMSA’s 2026 season wrapped up at the start of October 2026 at Road Atlanta, Georgia
The war in the Middle East disrupted the World Endurance Championship and a planned Asian Le Mans series
The series originated in 1998 when Don Panoz invited French enduro cars to compete in the United States
articles.conclusion: The surge in fan engagement makes sportscar racing a lucrative platform for streaming and sponsorship, but reliance on manufacturer support and exposure to geopolitical risks require careful operational planning.

articles.title: El enfado de Ucrania con Starlink, la compañía de Elon Musk, por las restricciones a la velocidad de internet que afectan a su ejército en el campo de batalla
articles.que_paso: SpaceX activó de forma inesperada un límite de velocidad de 160 km/h en las terminales Starlink usadas por el ejército ucraniano, lo que provocó la pérdida de conexión en misiones de drones y logística durante las dos noches anteriores. El asesor presidencial Serhiy Beskrestnov denunció la medida, mientras que Elon Musk atribuyó la restricción al gobierno de EE. UU. y el presidente Zelensky expresó sentirse traicionado y advirtió muertes por la decisión.
datos: El límite de velocidad impuesto es de 160 km/h y se activó de la noche a la mañana según informó Beskrestnov.
Beskrestnov afirmó que Ucrania no fue informada previamente sobre la restricción de Starlink.
Musk declaró en X que la limitación del sistema Starshield es responsabilidad del gobierno estadounidense, no de SpaceX.
Una fuente del Ministerio de Defensa ucraniano dijo a la BBC que la restricción dificultó operaciones de drones interceptores y logística de primera línea.
Zelensky dijo en entrevista con Piers Morgan que la medida provocará muertes y que se siente “traicionado” por Washington.
articles.conclusion: La dependencia de Ucrania en la infraestructura satelital privada expone sus operaciones militares a decisiones ajenas, subrayando la necesidad de asegurar canales de comunicación autónomos para mantener la capacidad defensiva.

articles.title: Cupón diario de la ONCE: comprobar sorteo del miércoles 14 de octubre
articles.que_paso: El miércoles 14 de octubre se realizó el sorteo del Cupón diario de la ONCE y se publicaron los números ganadores. Este sorteo forma parte de la oferta de loterías de la ONCE, que permite jugar de lunes a jueves. Además, la ONCE gestiona otros sorteos con distintas frecuencias y premios.
datos: El Cupón diario se celebra de lunes a jueves.
El sorteo del 14 de octubre corresponde al miércoles.
El Cuponazo se celebra los viernes y ofrece premios millonarios.
El Sueldazo Fin de Semana se celebra los sábados y domingos, con premios en efectivo y sueldos mensuales durante 20 años.
El Triplex de la ONCE se realiza de forma diaria con varios sorteos al día.
articles.conclusion: Conocer el calendario y la variedad de premios de la ONCE permite planificar mejor la participación y evaluar el potencial de ingresos de cada sorteo.

articles.title: Senators Question Meta’s Data Center Tax Strategy
articles.que_paso: Democrats on the Senate Finance Committee wrote to Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg asking for details on the company's $6.6 billion tax break package tied to its data‑center projects. The request comes as lawmakers examine whether the incentives comply with federal tax rules and represent a broader push to scrutinize large tech firms’ fiscal advantages.
datos: $6.6 billion in tax breaks for Meta’s data‑center investments
Letter addressed to Meta chief executive Mark Zuckerberg
Sent by Democratic members of the U.S. Senate Finance Committee
The tax incentives are linked to Meta’s construction of data‑center facilities
articles.conclusion: The inquiry signals heightened congressional oversight of tech‑company tax incentives, which could lead to tighter reporting requirements or revisions of future break allocations.

articles.title: Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza denies using AI to write prize-winning story
articles.que_paso: The Caine prize announced Simbarashe Kundizeza’s short story "The Blue Fighter" as its 2026 winner, then The Atlantic published a piece alleging the work was largely generated by AI. Kundizeza publicly denied the claim on X, and the prize organizers said they would investigate the allegation.
datos: The Blue Fighter was announced as the Caine prize winner on 6 October 2026.
The Atlantic article by Vauhini Vara was published five days later, on 11 October 2026, and cited the AI‑detection tool Pangram.
Pangram flagged the story as "almost completely" AI‑generated, except for an epigraph attributed to South African writer Vangile Gantsho.
Kundizeza’s denial was posted on X, stating he wrote the story without generative AI.
The Caine prize issued a statement that it is reviewing the allegations using a human‑centred approach.
articles.conclusion: The dispute highlights the growing tension between AI detection tools and literary credibility, urging prize bodies to establish clear verification processes.

articles.title: “¡Dame la puta toalla, coño!”: Jódar pierde los nervios en Shanghái ante un recogepelotas y acaba sancionado
articles.que_paso: Jódar, tenista madrileño, perdió los nervios durante su partido en Shanghai tras un altercado con un recogepelotas y recibió una sanción. Aun así, remontó un primer set contra el holandés Van de Zandschulp y se clasificó para los cuartos de final donde enfrentará a Ruud.
datos: Jódar es originario de Madrid
El marcador contra Van de Zandschulp fue 6-7(4), 6-4, 6-2
El encuentro duró 2 h 30 min
El incidente ocurrió en Shanghái y resultó en una sanción para Jódar
Su próximo rival en cuartos será el holandés Ruud
articles.conclusion: El episodio subraya que la gestión emocional es crucial en torneos de alto nivel y que la sanción podría afectar su desempeño contra Ruud.

articles.title: As a TV enthusiast, I was hoping for more from the Apple TV 4K
articles.que_paso: Apple unveiled the fourth‑generation Apple TV 4K, raising its price to $300 and offering only a 128 GB Wi‑Fi‑plus‑Ethernet model, while adding a new processor, Find My remote tracking, far‑field Siri mics and an AV1 video decoder, but omitting audio‑passthrough and 120 fps output that many users expected.
datos: The new Apple TV 4K costs $300, up from the previous generation’s lower‑priced options
Apple discontinued the 64 GB Wi‑Fi‑only configuration, keeping only a 128 GB Wi‑Fi + Ethernet version
It now includes a dedicated AV1 hardware decoder for higher‑quality streaming
The remote can be located via Find My and features built‑in far‑field microphones for Siri
Apple added support for creating a surround‑sound system using HomePod 2 and HomePod Mini 2 speakers, but did not add audio‑passthrough or 120 fps video output
articles.conclusion: The steep price and lack of key audio and high‑frame‑rate features mean the device mainly appeals to existing Apple ecosystem users, while power users may find better value in competing streamers or waiting for future updates.

articles.title: Sánchez cree que si PP y Vox llegan al Gobierno de España "firman la carta de defunción del Estado del Bienestar"
articles.que_paso: Pedro Sánchez advirtió en un mitin en Zaragoza que la posible coalición entre el PP y Vox acabaría con el modelo de Estado del Bienestar, en el contexto de la campaña para las elecciones generales del 29 de noviembre.
datos: Pedro Sánchez es presidente del Gobierno de España y candidato del PSOE a la reelección
El discurso se realizó el viernes en Zaragoza
Las elecciones generales están previstas para el 29 de noviembre de 2026
Sánchez mencionó al PP y a Vox como posibles socios de gobierno
Afirmó que esa alianza “firmaría la carta de defunción del Estado del Bienestar”
articles.conclusion: El mensaje busca movilizar al electorado del PSOE resaltando riesgos para la protección social, lo que podría influir en la decisión de los votantes ante la posible coalición de la derecha.

articles.title: El puerto de Las Palmas se transformará con una ambiciosa obra: una descomunal cantidad de roca escondida bajo el mar
articles.que_paso: El Gobierno de Canarias aprobó en julio la licitación para construir un nuevo muelle adosado al dique Reina Sofía Sur en el puerto de Las Palmas, con un presupuesto de 45,3 millones de euros sin IGIC. La obra incluye la creación de una base artificial y la instalación de grandes cajones de hormigón armado que se hundirán controladamente para soportar buques de gran calado.
datos: Licencia de obra autorizada en julio de 2026 por el Gobierno de Canarias
Presupuesto asignado: 45,3 millones de euros, exento de IGIC
Profundidad de agua prevista en el frente de atraque: 20 metros
Los cajones estructurales son de hormigón armado con compartimentos internos que les permiten flotar
El hundimiento de los cajones se logrará introduciendo agua controlada como lastre
articles.conclusion: La solución permite al puerto de Las Palmas recibir buques de mayor calado, ampliando su capacidad operativa y mejorando la competitividad del puerto en el tráfico internacional.

articles.title: Save up to 20 percent on gift cards for REI, Barnes & Noble, and more
articles.que_paso: Google Play is offering a limited‑time promotion that provides up to 20 percent off gift cards from roughly 30 retailers, including Barnes & Noble, REI and GameStop. The discounts are available through October 19, 2026 and require a Google Play account, though no Android device is needed.
datos: The promotion offers up to 20 percent off gift cards.
It runs until October 19, 2026.
20 percent off a $50 Barnes & Noble gift card.
20 percent off a $100 REI gift card.
10 percent off a $100 GameStop gift card.
Discounts also apply to Calm and Duolingo subscriptions.
articles.conclusion: Purchasing discounted gift cards can lower costs for employee incentives or personal spending, while the added subscription discounts encourage broader use of Google Play services.

articles.title: Mejores escritorios elevables. Cuál comprar y 7 modelos recomendados
articles.que_paso: El artículo analiza el mercado de escritorios elevables y destaca siete modelos, centrándose en la línea eléctrica de Flexispot como opción principal para trabajadores remotos que buscan una estación de trabajo ergonómica. Se describen sus características técnicas y se comparan con otras alternativas de bajo coste.
datos: Flexispot ofrece escritorios con anchos entre 140 cm y 200 cm.
El rango de ajuste de altura es de 70 cm a 119 cm.
La capacidad de carga máxima es de 100 kg (algunos modelos llegan a 120 kg).
Cada escritorio incluye motor doble y sistema anticolisión.
El panel de control permite guardar hasta 4 posiciones de altura y cuenta con puertos USB y gestión de cables.
articles.conclusion: Un escritorio elevable con estas especificaciones permite alternar entre estar sentado y de pie, reduciendo riesgos de dolor lumbar y mejorando la productividad en entornos de trabajo híbrido.

articles.title: Bleached Coral Rebounded After Touching Healthy Coral, Study Finds
articles.que_paso: Researchers conducted an experiment where bleached corals were placed in direct contact with healthy corals of the same genetic lineage. The diseased specimens recovered rapidly, according to the scientists who reported the study.
datos: The experiment paired sick corals with healthy corals of identical genotype.
Recovery was described as occurring at “incredible” speed.
The findings were reported by scientists in a study titled “Bleached Coral Rebounded After Touching Healthy Coral, Study Finds.”
The study focused on corals of the same genetic make‑up.
The observation involved direct physical contact between the coral pairs.
articles.conclusion: The result indicates that genetic matching and physical proximity can accelerate coral recovery, offering a practical avenue for reef restoration projects.

articles.title: A su PVP, esta CPU Ryzen de AMD es un salvavidas para actualizar muchos PC en plena crisis. Y ahora, en oferta, lo es mucho más
articles.que_paso: AMD lanzó una edición conmemorativa del Ryzen 7 5800X3D para celebrar los diez años de la plataforma AM4 y, tras una breve rebaja, el procesador pasa a costar 349,99 €, ofreciendo a los usuarios de PCs con socket AM4 una mejora de rendimiento sin necesidad de cambiar placa base ni memoria.
datos: Precio inicial de la edición conmemorativa: aproximadamente 360 €
Precio rebajado anunciado: 349,99 €
Lanzamiento de la edición en 2026 para el décimo aniversario de AM4
Especificaciones del chip: 8 núcleos y 16 hilos con frecuencias superiores a 4 GHz
No requiere actualización a placa base AM5 ni a memoria DDR5 para su instalación
articles.conclusion: Esta oferta permite actualizar ordenadores existentes de forma económica, evitando la inversión adicional que implica migrar a la plataforma AM5, lo que es relevante para mantener la productividad sin grandes gastos de capital.

articles.title: El “desastroso” estreno de la portavoz de la Casa Blanca provoca apuestas sobre su permanencia
articles.que_paso: Katie Zacharia, la nueva portavoz de la Casa Blanca, tuvo un desempeño torpe y poco fluido en su primera comparecencia ante los medios, lo que alimentó dudas sobre su continuidad en el cargo.
datos: Katie Zacharia fue nombrada portavoz oficial de la Casa Blanca el 1 de octubre de 2026.
Su primera comparecencia ante la prensa se realizó el 14 de octubre de 2026.
Durante la intervención cometió varios errores de pronunciación y mostró vacilaciones al responder preguntas.
Analistas políticos de Washington expresaron sospechas sobre la veracidad de su currículum.
El portavoz del Departamento de Prensa de la Casa Blanca declaró que se revisará su desempeño antes de decidir su permanencia.
articles.conclusion: Un portavoz poco convincente puede debilitar la capacidad de la Casa Blanca para comunicar su agenda y generar incertidumbre en la gestión de crisis.

articles.title: Enfrentamientos con la policía y el Ministerio de educación en llamas en el segundo día de protestas estudiantiles en Albania
articles.que_paso: El miércoles 15 de octubre de 2026, estudiantes en Tirana continuaron su protesta por la reforma del sistema educativo, lo que derivó en enfrentamientos con la policía y un incendio en el edificio del Ministerio de Educación. Fue el segundo día consecutivo de manifestaciones en la capital albanesa.
datos: La manifestación tuvo lugar en la capital, Tirana, Albania.
Fue el segundo día de protestas estudiantiles en la misma ubicación.
El incidente ocurrió el miércoles 15 de octubre de 2026.
Los manifestantes se enfrentaron físicamente con la policía local.
El edificio del Ministerio de Educación sufrió un incendio durante los disturbios.
Los estudiantes demandan mejoras estructurales y de financiación en el sistema educativo.
articles.conclusion: El episodio muestra un riesgo de interrupción operativa en el sector educativo albanés y la necesidad de vigilar la estabilidad social para anticipar posibles impactos en proyectos y suministros relacionados con la educación.

articles.title: El Comité de Disciplina sanciona al Rayo con un cierre parcial de Vallecas por el lanzamiento de objetos en el partido contra el Athletic
articles.que_paso: Durante el partido entre el Rayo Vallecano y el Athletic, seguidores del Rayo lanzaron aviones de papel y otros objetos al campo, lo que obligó al árbitro Sánchez Martínez a suspender el encuentro. El Comité de Disciplina de la RFEF determinó que el club es responsable de una infracción grave y dictó una sanción disciplinaria.
datos: El Comité de Disciplina de la RFEF multó al Rayo Vallecano con 6.000 euros.
Impuso una clausura parcial del estadio, limitada al fondo situado sobre la zona de vestuarios, por un partido.
La sanción se aplicará en el partido del 24 de octubre de 2026 contra el Elche.
El árbitro Sánchez Martínez suspendió el encuentro contra el Athletic tras el lanzamiento de objetos.
El incidente tuvo lugar el sábado 12 de octubre de 2026 en el estadio de Vallecas.
La RFEF advirtió que una reincidencia provocará el cierre total de las instalaciones deportivas del club.
articles.conclusion: La medida muestra la firmeza de la RFEF ante alteraciones del orden en los partidos y obliga al Rayo a reforzar la gestión de la afición para evitar sanciones que afecten su calendario y finanzas.

articles.title: La izquierda se encamina a negociaciones 'in extremis' sin disponer aún de un mapa claro de coaliciones
articles.que_paso: Los partidos de la izquierda española, Frente Amplio y Podemos, se están preparando para iniciar negociaciones de último momento sin haber definido aún un esquema claro de alianzas, y la unidad entre ellos sigue bloqueada en áreas estratégicas.
datos: Frente Amplio y Podemos mantienen distancias entre sí
Se menciona la hipótesis de un posible acuerdo entre ambos partidos
La unidad está estancada en territorios clave
No existe un mapa claro de coaliciones para las negociaciones
Las negociaciones se describen como "in extremis"
articles.conclusion: Esta falta de claridad en la coalición dificulta la capacidad de la izquierda para presentar una alternativa unificada en las próximas contiendas electorales.

articles.title: La Fiscalía rectifica y avala ante el juez que la Audiencia Nacional es competente para investigar la querella contra Julio Iglesias
articles.que_paso: La Fiscalía ha cambiado de criterio y ahora afirma que la Audiencia Nacional puede investigar la querella por agresión sexual contra Julio Iglesias, tras el informe presentado por el fiscal Vicente González Mota al juez Antonio Piña. La decisión revierte la postura anterior de la teniente fiscal Marta Durántez, que había archivado la denuncia por falta de jurisdicción. El juez deberá decidir si abre una investigación en España.
datos: Vicente González Mota envió un informe al magistrado Antonio Piña respaldado por la fiscal Beatriz Sánchez Álvarez
La querella fue presentada por dos ex‑trabajadoras, identificadas como Rebeca y Laura, que laboraron en mansiones de Iglesias en República Dominicana y Bahamas en 2021
La fiscal Marta Durántez archivó la denuncia inicial en enero, argumentando ausencia de vínculo territorial o personal con España
Julio Iglesias, aunque tiene nacionalidad española y posee propiedades en el país, no reside ni mantiene su centro de vida en España según la valoración de Durántez
Un juzgado de lo Contencioso‑Administrativo de la Audiencia Nacional falló contra la Fiscalía obligando al Ministerio Público a entregar las diligencias del caso
articles.conclusion: Esta reversión abre la posibilidad de que España ejerza jurisdicción sobre hechos cometidos en el extranjero, lo que podría traducirse en una investigación penal contra el cantante y sentar un precedente para casos de trata y abuso laboral con vínculos internacionales.

articles.title: 22 People Got Together For a Dinner Party. So Did Their A.I. Agents.
articles.que_paso: A group of twenty‑two individuals convened for a dinner, and each brought along their personal artificial‑intelligence agents, allowing the bots to converse with one another during the meal. The event illustrates the growing practice of integrating AI companions into everyday social settings.
datos: 22 people attended the dinner party
Each participant also had an AI agent present
The gathering was described as a dinner party where AI agents interacted
The article notes that AI bots are spreading and being observed interacting
articles.conclusion: The episode shows AI agents moving into shared social spaces, implying that operations teams will need to manage AI‑human interaction dynamics and the data they produce.

articles.title: Could AI ‘change the stakes’ in the development of bioweapons?
articles.que_paso: In his 2026 annual threat briefing, MI5 chief Sir Ken McCallum warned that artificial intelligence could fundamentally alter bioweapon development, prompting experts to assess both low‑skill terrorist use and sophisticated state‑level applications. Recent incidents—including a 2025 Indian police bust of a doctor using AI chatbots to synthesize ricin and Anthropic’s September 2026 report of five scientists attempting virus manipulation with its Claude model—illustrate the emerging practical risks.
datos: Sir Ken McCallum, head of MI5, warned AI could "change the stakes" on bioweapons in his 2026 annual speech
Dr Filippa Lentzos of King’s College London said AI amplifies existing expertise rather than replacing it
In 2025 Indian police uncovered a suspected bioterror plot where a doctor used AI chatbots to help produce ricin with kitchen tools
Anthropic reported five cases in September 2026 of scientists in unnamed countries using its Claude chatbot to plan mutations in a highly pathogenic bird flu virus
A MIT exercise showed AI chatbots could, within an hour, list four potential pandemic pathogens, detail synthetic DNA creation steps, and name DNA synthesis firms unlikely to screen orders
articles.conclusion: The examples show AI can lower technical barriers for malicious actors, making policy controls and monitoring of AI tools essential to prevent bioweapon misuse.

articles.title: El PP critica las "mentiras" del PSOE contra Feijóo por las pensiones y promete subirlas conforme IPC si gobiernan
articles.que_paso: Los portavoces del Partido Popular denunciaron este miércoles que el PSOE ha difundido informaciones falsas sobre el presidente del partido, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, en relación con la política de pensiones, y reiteraron su compromiso de actualizar las pensiones según el Índice de Precios al Consumidor si llegan al Gobierno.
datos: Los críticos del PP emitieron sus declaraciones el miércoles.
Se refirieron al PSOE como fuente de "mentiras" sobre Feijóo y las pensiones.
El PP prometió revalorizar las pensiones conforme al IPC.
El compromiso está condicionado a que el PP gobierne desde el Palacio de la Moncloa.
Alberto Núñez Feijóo es mencionado como el líder del PP en la polémica.
articles.conclusion: Esta postura muestra que la política de pensiones será un punto de confrontación electoral y que, de ganar, el PP aplicará un índice de ajuste que podría afectar la evolución de los ingresos de los pensionistas.

articles.title: Netflix, Facing Slowing Growth, Cuts 6% of Its Work Force
articles.que_paso: Netflix announced it will cut 6% of its workforce as the company confronts a more than 40% decline in its share price over the past year, which it attributes to stalling subscriber engagement. The move reflects an effort to reduce costs amid the slowdown.
datos: Netflix is reducing its staff by 6% of its total workforce
The company's share price has fallen by over 40% in the last twelve months
The layoffs were announced in a statement released on October 15, 2026
Netflix cited stagnant user engagement as a key factor in its recent performance
articles.conclusion: The workforce reduction signals that Netflix is tightening operations to preserve margins as growth stalls, a warning for investors and managers to prioritize efficiency and engagement metrics.

articles.title: Jordi Hereu: “El ciudadano residente y el trabajador deben estar en el epicentro de las políticas de turismo”
articles.que_paso: Jordi Hereu, ministro de Industria y Turismo, intervino en el foro CREO organizado por CincoDías y Prisa Media, donde subrayó la necesidad de que las políticas turísticas pongan al ciudadano residente y al trabajador en el centro del desarrollo. También destacó la transformación del modelo económico español hacia una mayor diversificación más allá del turismo de sol y playa.
datos: El valor económico aportado por el sector turismo aumentó un 8% hasta agosto, alcanzando los 99.000 millones de euros.
Se han tutelado 3.500 millones de euros de inversión en los últimos cuatro años para reorientar la estrategia turística.
El FMI prevé un crecimiento económico del 2,5% para España, mientras que el Banco de España estima un 2,6% y el Gobierno cifras similares.
En los últimos años, las actividades de servicios profesionales científicos y servicios a la empresa crecieron un 52%.
España se dirige a superar los 100 millones de visitantes extranjeros en 2026.
La industria de defensa, aeronáutica y espacio registró su mayor facturación en 2025, según el informe anual de PwC.
articles.conclusion: Este enfoque indica que España busca un turismo más sostenible y orientado a la calidad de vida de sus residentes, mientras su diversificación industrial refuerza la resiliencia económica.

articles.title: A New World of Lung Cancer Therapy Awaits Pope Leo
articles.que_paso: New cancer therapies have cut the lung‑cancer death rate to roughly half of its 1990s level, even though the disease still tops the list of cancer fatalities. Researchers and clinicians are credited with the advances, which are reshaping treatment protocols worldwide.
datos: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer death globally.
The mortality rate for lung cancer in 2026 is about 50% of its 1990s level.
Newly developed treatments such as targeted therapies and immunotherapies are cited as primary drivers of the decline.
The reduction is attributed partly to therapeutic advances rather than changes in smoking prevalence.
The article was published on October 15, 2026.
articles.conclusion: The drop demonstrates that recent therapeutic innovations are delivering measurable health benefits, underscoring the value of continued investment in advanced treatment research.

articles.title: Fernando García, guardia civil de tráfico: "cobramos 100 euros más que otros agentes. La gente no quiere jugarse la vida por ese dinero"
articles.que_paso: La Asociación Española de Guardias Civiles denunció que la unidad de tráfico carece de personal porque los puestos ofertados reciben muy pocas solicitudes, lo que deja vacantes en la vigilancia de carreteras. Esta escasez se atribuye a la escasa diferencia salarial respecto a otras especialidades.
datos: Se convocaron 20 plazas para el examen de Atestados B y 40 para cabos de Atestados C.
Solo se presentaron 2 aspirantes a las 20 plazas de Atestados B y 4 aspirantes a las 40 plazas de cabos.
De las 60 plazas ofertadas, apenas 6 candidatos fueron aprobados, cubriendo el 10 % de los puestos.
En total hay 160 plazas para guardias civiles y solo 51 aspirantes.
Un guardia civil percibe unos 26 000 euros brutos anuales antes de trienios; los cabos superan los 28 000 euros.
articles.conclusion: La falta de candidatos compromete la capacidad de control del tráfico y sugiere que es necesario revisar los incentivos salariales y complementos para atraer personal.

articles.title: Zelenski quita hierro a las tensiones con Trump pero pedirá explicaciones sobre las restricciones de Starlink
articles.que_paso: Zelenski intentó minimizar las fricciones con Trump desde Londres, señalando que buscará aclaraciones sobre las limitaciones impuestas a Starlink. La medida se produce tras el anuncio de Trump, el viernes anterior, de un pacto con Putin para distribuir combustible ruso en los mercados internacionales.
datos: Volodímir Zelenski habló desde Londres el miércoles
Donald Trump anunció el viernes un acuerdo con Vladimir Putin para distribuir combustible ruso
El acuerdo implica la venta de combustible ruso en los mercados globales
Zelenski solicitará explicaciones sobre las restricciones de Starlink
El presidente ucraniano busca reducir la tensión con EE. UU.
articles.conclusion: El gesto de Zelenski indica una estrategia de mitigar la fricción diplomática mientras protege la conectividad crítica de Ucrania, lo que podría influir en la cooperación futura entre EE. UU. y Ucrania.
